sources.title: Original Step 3.5 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Names the original sparse MoE reasoning and agent model, Apache-2.0, nominal 196B backbone and approximately 11B active parameters. Its architecture table says 196.81B including a 0.81B prediction head; the released checkpoint actually includes three prediction heads, which are counted separately below. No 2603 or 3.7 specification is substituted.

sources.title: Exact Step 3.5 Flash checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: 45 backbone layers, first three dense and 42 MoE; hidden size 4096, vocabulary 128896, top 8 of 288 routed experts plus shared expert. Full attention has 64 query heads, sliding attention 96, each with 8 KV heads and 128 dimensions. Config specifies 262144 context, three next-token prediction layers, untied embeddings, BF16 weights and no quantization.

sources.title: Complete checkpoint index and bounded headers from all 44 shards
sources.evidence: Fetched only 8-byte safetensors prefixes and bounded JSON headers for all 44 indexed shards using verified HTTP 206 ranges. All 804 keys, shard assignments, dtypes, contiguous byte offsets and configured shapes reconcile. The index contains 398768626944 bytes: 762 BF16 learned tensors plus 42 F32 auxiliary router-bias tensors. No weight payload downloaded.

sources.title: Original Hugging Face backbone implementation
sources.evidence: Static inspection resolves attention gates, Q/K norms, packed expert tensors, shared experts, all ordinary norms and separate vocabulary matrices. Router biases are requires_grad=False auxiliary balancing state; rotary frequencies are nonpersistent buffers. The debug Hugging Face implementation instantiates only the 45-layer backbone, so its module set alone is insufficient for complete checkpoint accounting.

sources.title: Pinned vLLM implementation and loading rules for released Step 3.5 MTP tensors
sources.evidence: Instantiates three independent MTP layers at indices 45–47, each with embedding/hidden norms, concatenation projection, a dense sliding-attention block and its own output matrix and norm. The checkpoint shared_head name does not imply tied output weights. Loader maps transformer.shared_head.output to each independently instantiated head. Shared input embedding is counted once; no external draft checkpoint is added.

sources.title: Pinned vLLM Step 3.5 decoder implementation
sources.evidence: Decoder-layer configuration handles the original attention schedule and dense FFNs in MTP layers. Confirms the split between 45-layer target and three additional speculative layers; packed runtime projections map to the individual checkpoint matrices.

sources.title: Step 3.5 Flash technical report, architecture section
sources.evidence: Describes 45-layer hybrid-attention MoE backbone with 3 dense and 42 MoE layers, top 8 of 288 routed experts plus one shared expert, and three MTP heads. Each MTP head adds approximately 0.81B. Modules 2–3 were cloned and then jointly trained, not permanently tied. Reports nominal 196B and 11B figures; it does not explicitly define vocabulary inclusion in the active count.

sources.title: Original checkpoint chat template
sources.evidence: Serializes explicit thinking traces and model-selected XML function calls, tool declarations, arguments and tool responses. A generic image placeholder branch exists, but there is no vision encoder/projector or multimodal configuration in this complete text checkpoint; the placeholder alone is not visual capability evidence.

sources.title: Official Step 3.5 API model guide and variant distinction
sources.evidence: Calls step-3.5-flash the base reasoning/tool version and separately identifies step-3.5-flash-2603 as a tuned agent version with low/high effort. States 256 K context, 196B/11B nominal MoE and tools/tool_choice. Those 2603-specific effort settings are not copied to the original.

sources.title: Dated official Step 3.5 Flash launch announcement
sources.evidence: Indexed primary announcement is dated February 2, 2026 and explicitly says the model is fully available through API/app and released weight links. Direct raw HTML is a JavaScript shell; dated article text was accessible through the search index. This establishes the documented developer launch, not proof that no private or provider preview existed earlier.

sources.title: Original developer checkpoint history
sources.evidence: Repository created February 1, 2026; complete release_mtp3_bf16 upload February 1 at 16:24:53 UTC. Upload history is not proof of first public visibility and is not used as the release day.

sources.title: Exact hosted original Step 3.5 endpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Exact identifier is text-to-text and exposes 262144 context. created=1769728337 corresponds to January 29, 2026, preceding the developer launch; the listing timestamp does not independently establish public serving on that date. Provider page also labels it released January 29; this unresolved discrepancy is preserved rather than presented as primary developer confirmation.

sources.title: Apache 2.0 license in official release repository
sources.evidence: Full Apache 2.0 license is present in the official release repository; exact model card independently declares Apache 2.0 for the model. No standalone LICENSE file is present in the Hugging Face tree at the audited revision.

name.note: Original release; distinct from step-3.5-flash-2603 and Step 3.7 Flash.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit developer availability announcement located is February 2. January 29 is a conflicting provider listing date, not verified public serving; February 1 is a checkpoint upload. Preserve this distinction, and do not substitute the February 12 technical-page update for launch.

open_weights.note: The complete original checkpoint is publicly downloadable, including three MTP heads.

license.note: Model card and official release repository agree on Apache 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Exact complete learned checkpoint count: 199384301376 serialized elements minus 12096 auxiliary frozen router-bias values =199384289280. Includes 196956118272 backbone parameters and three separate 809390336-parameter MTP heads, totaling 2428171008. All 804 indexed shapes reconcile; there are no quantized scales, persistent rotary tensors or additional uncounted learned modules. The nominal 196B/196.81B prose is not a complete exact count of the three-head checkpoint.

active_parameters_b.note: Official approximate 11B per-token figure, retained at published precision. Vocabulary/MTP inclusion is not explicitly defined. Top 8 routing gives 11987311872 active backbone parameters when both full vocabulary matrices are counted, or 10931395840 when both are excluded. The latter rounds to 11B; this is an accounting inference, not a declared developer convention. Speculative heads add workload-dependent execution and are not silently folded into the nominal figure.

architecture.note: Decoder-only sparse MoE Transformer: 45 backbone layers, 3 dense and 42 MoE; 288 routed experts/top 8 plus shared expert; full GQA interleaved with 512-token sliding attention and head-wise gates. Three dense MTP modules supplement the backbone.

context_window.note: Exact checkpoint max_seq_len and max_position_embeddings are 262144, corresponding to the advertised 256 K; this corrects the baseline decimal 256000.

modalities.note: Text-only checkpoint and exact hosted modality mapping. No vision/audio encoder or projector exists. Generic template image markers do not establish a multimodal model; later 3.7 vision capability is not transferred.

reasoning.note: Explicit reasoning model with thinking traces. The original generation template opens a thinking section; the 2603 low/high-effort option belongs to that later variant.

tool_call.note: Exact template and API documentation establish model-selected function calls and tool responses.

description.value: Text reasoning model with sparse MoE routing, hybrid sliding-window attention, tool calling, and three multi-token prediction heads.
description.note: Replaces unsupported multimodal claim and promotional flash-lane wording with exact technical properties.

patch.notes: Complete original checkpoint: 199.38428928B learned parameters, comprising 196.956118272B backbone plus 2.428171008B across three MTP heads; excludes 12096 auxiliary router-bias values. The card’s 196B backbone and 196.81B one-head table are nominal and do not equal the complete three-head count. The 11B active figure is nominal with unstated vocabulary/MTP accounting. Configured context is 262144. Official public launch is documented on 2026-02-02; the earlier 2026-01-29 provider listing does not establish first serving, and first-public visibility before the announcement remains unresolved. This is the original text-only model, separate from 2603 and 3.7 revisions.

summary: Adds verified complete 199.38428928B learned count from all 44 bounded shard headers and reconciled backbone/MTP implementations, plus nominal 11B active, MoE architecture and Apache 2.0. Separates backbone from three independently trained MTP heads and auxiliary router bias. Corrects context to 262144 and documented launch to February 2 while retaining the earlier provider-date conflict. Confirms reasoning/tools/text-only modalities and removes unsupported multimodal description. No full weights downloaded.
